svg.title: Railway conductor — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as railway conductor, wearing a work uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A notched passenger ticket has a punched hole and separated stub marks above a handled ticket punch. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
